meta.note: Day offsets are relative to the date the dog arrives at (or is shipped to) the destination: negative = before. Every rule carries a source and last_verified date. status: verified = read on the official page; partial = official classification verified, some timings taken from official certificates of other exporting countries or secondary sources; unverified = needs an official source before going live.

GB.name: United Kingdom (Great Britain)
GB.classification: UAE is a listed country: no rabies blood test

steps.title: Microchip
steps.detail: Must be implanted before the rabies vaccination.

steps.title: Rabies vaccination
steps.detail: Travel at least 21 full days after the first vaccination (or last of the primary course).

steps.title: Great Britain pet health certificate
steps.detail: Signed, stamped and dated by an official veterinarian. Pet must enter GB within 10 days of issue.

steps.title: Tapeworm treatment (dogs)
steps.detail: Given by a vet no less than 24 hours and no more than 5 days before arrival.

steps.title: Non-commercial declaration
steps.detail: Required if not selling or transferring ownership.

steps.title: Approved route
steps.detail: Must travel on an approved route (cargo into an approved GB airport).

steps.title: Banned breeds check
steps.detail: Banned breeds cannot enter without a valid Certificate of Exemption.

sources.title: GOV.UK: Bringing your pet to Great Britain
GOV.UK: Which pet travel document you need
GOV.UK: Great Britain pet health certificate

EU.name: European Union
EU.classification: UAE is listed (Annex II, Implementing Reg. (EU) 2026/636): no rabies blood test

steps.title: Microchip
steps.detail: Vaccine date must not precede the microchip date.

steps.title: Rabies vaccination
steps.detail: Dog at least 12 weeks old at vaccination; validity starts 21 days after primary vaccination.

steps.title: EU animal health certificate
steps.detail: Issued by an official (or authorised + endorsed) vet; valid 10 days from issue until checks at the EU point of entry; then 6 months for onward EU travel (or until rabies vaccine expires).

steps.title: Tapeworm (Echinococcus) treatment
steps.detail: Only for Finland, Ireland, Malta (and Northern Ireland, Norway): 24–120 hours before entry.

steps.title: Owner declaration (non-commercial)
steps.detail: Owner must travel with the pet or within 5 days of it; max 5 pets.

steps.title: Travellers' point of entry
steps.detail: Enter through a designated travellers' point of entry for document and ID checks.

sources.title: European Commission: Bringing a pet into the EU from a non-EU country
European Commission: Listing of non-EU countries

FR.name: France
FR.classification: EU rules apply: UAE is listed (Annex II, Implementing Reg. (EU) 2026/636), so no rabies blood test

steps.title: Microchip
steps.detail: Vaccine date must not precede the microchip date.

steps.title: Rabies vaccination
steps.detail: Dog at least 12 weeks old at vaccination; validity starts 21 days after primary vaccination.

steps.title: EU animal health certificate
steps.detail: Issued by an official (or authorised + endorsed) vet; valid 10 days from issue until checks at the EU point of entry; then 6 months for onward EU travel (or until rabies vaccine expires).

steps.title: Owner declaration (non-commercial)
steps.detail: Owner must travel with the pet or within 5 days of it; max 5 pets.

steps.title: Travellers' point of entry
steps.detail: Enter through a designated travellers' point of entry for document and ID checks.

steps.title: France dangerous-dog rules
steps.detail: France restricts 'category 1' attack-type dogs (import of these is understood to be banned) and requires a detention permit for category 2. Check your dog's breed or type before booking.

US.name: United States
US.classification: UAE is on CDC's high-risk dog rabies list (updated 15 Apr 2026)

steps.title: Microchip
steps.detail: Implanted before the rabies vaccine or the vaccine is invalid.

steps.title: Rabies vaccination
steps.detail: First vaccine at 12 weeks or older and at least 28 days before entry. Dog must be at least 6 months old on arrival.

steps.title: Rabies serology titer (CDC-approved lab)
steps.detail: Blood drawn at least 30 days after first valid vaccine and at least 28 days before entry. Without a valid titer the dog must do a 28-day quarantine at a CDC-registered facility.

steps.title: Reserve CDC-registered animal care facility
steps.detail: Mandatory for foreign-vaccinated dogs from high-risk countries: exam + revaccination (+28-day quarantine if no valid titer). Fly directly into that airport.

steps.title: Certification of Foreign Rabies Vaccination and Microchip
steps.detail: Completed by your vet and endorsed by an official government vet no more than 30 days before travel; single use.

steps.title: CDC Dog Import Form
steps.detail: Online, free; recommended a few days before travel. Receipt valid only for the stated arrival date and airport.

sources.title: CDC: High-risk countries for dog rabies
CDC: Foreign-vaccinated dogs from high-risk countries

CA.name: Canada
CA.classification: UAE is not on CFIA's rabies-free list: a rabies vaccination certificate is required
CA.lead_note: No official waiting period found after vaccination; we plan 30 days from scratch as a buffer.

steps.title: Rabies vaccination certificate
steps.detail: Required for dogs over 3 months. Issued by a licensed vet, in English or French, identifying the dog (breed, colour, weight) and showing current vaccination with vaccine name, date and validity.

steps.title: Health certificate (puppies only)
steps.detail: Dogs 8 months or older travelling as personal pets need only the rabies certificate. Unaccompanied dogs under 8 months need a vet health certificate issued within 72 hours of arrival.

steps.title: Microchip (recommended)
steps.detail: Not listed by CFIA for personal pets, but it ties the dog to its paperwork. Airlines and the UAE export side expect one.

steps.title: Border inspection
steps.detail: Canada Border Services Agency checks documents on arrival and may refer non-compliant dogs to CFIA. No quarantine for compliant personal pets.

alerts: Since 28 Sep 2022 Canada bans commercial dogs (resale, adoption, breeding) from countries at high risk of dog rabies. Personal pets travelling with their owner are not described as commercial; confirm if your dog is a recent rescue being rehomed.

sources.title: CFIA: Bringing animals to Canada (personal pets)
CFIA: Dogs (commercial import, high-risk ban)
USDA APHIS: Pet travel to Canada (relays CFIA rules)

AU.name: Australia
AU.classification: UAE is an approved Group 3 country (rabies present but controlled)

steps.title: Microchip
steps.detail: Microchip number must appear on the permit, every lab report, the RNATT declaration and the health certificate.

steps.title: Identity check by government vet (optional, recommended)
steps.detail: Done before the RNATT blood draw; cuts minimum quarantine from 30 to 10 days.

steps.title: Rabies vaccination
steps.detail: Must be current at RNATT and export.

steps.title: RNATT blood test
steps.detail: Export at least 180 days after the date the sample arrives at the lab; RNATT valid 12 months from collection.

steps.title: Import permit (BICON)
steps.detail: Apply after the RNATT declaration is in place; book Mickleham quarantine.

steps.title: Pre-export tests
steps.detail: Leishmania (all dogs), Brucella canis (entire dogs), Ehrlichia canis within 45 days of export, per DAFF-negotiated certificates (UAE certificate to confirm).

steps.title: Post-arrival quarantine
steps.detail: Mickleham, Victoria: minimum 10 days with identity check, 30 days without.

alerts: DAFF asks owners affected by the Middle East conflict to contact the department (imports@aff.gov.au); requirements unchanged.

DAFF: Rabies vaccination and tests
DAFF: Cats and dogs FAQ (RNATT validity)

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.classification: Category 3 (rabies controlled) per secondary sources; category list sits in MPI-STD-SAA Schedule 9

steps.title: Official vet microchip ID check
steps.detail: If RNATT sample is 6–12 months before shipment: scan before the sample. If 3–6 months: first scan at least 6 months before shipment, second before the sample. Required for all imports from 1 Apr 2027 (checks from 1 Oct 2026).

steps.title: Rabies vaccination
steps.detail: At 12 weeks or older; continuously valid; a primary vaccination must be at least 6 months before shipment.

steps.title: RNATT blood test
steps.detail: Sample 3–12 months before shipment, result at least 0.5 IU/mL.

steps.title: Import permit + quarantine booking
steps.detail: Apply at least 8 weeks before; allow 30 working days. Include rabies records, RNATT, Rabies Certification Form, signed quarantine booking.

steps.title: External parasite treatment #1
steps.detail: At least 14 days before the Babesia gibsoni blood sample; continuous protection to shipment.

steps.title: Internal parasite treatment #1
steps.detail: Within 30 days before shipment and at least 14 days before treatment #2.

steps.title: Blood tests
steps.detail: Babesia gibsoni (IFA/ELISA + PCR), Leishmania, Leptospira (or treatment), heartworm (if 7+ months), Brucella canis (entire dogs): samples within 30 days before shipment.

steps.title: External parasite treatment #2
steps.detail: Within 16 days before shipment.

steps.title: Internal parasite + heartworm + Angiostrongylus treatment
steps.detail: Within 5 days before shipment.

steps.title: Pre-export vet inspection
steps.detail: Within 2 days before shipment; free of parasites, disease signs, recent bites.

steps.title: Arrival and quarantine
steps.detail: Manifested cargo into Auckland or Christchurch only; minimum 10 days in an MPI-approved facility.

alerts: Transition: 2021 IHS may be used until 1 Apr 2027; this database uses the 2026 IHS.

sources.title: MPI: Import Health Standard Cats and Dogs 2026 (CATSDOGS.GEN)
MPI: Bringing cats and dogs to NZ

RU.name: Russia
RU.classification: No rabies blood test for any origin; up to 2 pets per owner without a Rosselkhoznadzor permit

steps.title: Microchip (recommended)
steps.detail: Identification is required; an ISO microchip is the safest way to match the dog to its papers.

steps.title: Rabies vaccination
steps.detail: At least 20 days before travel and within the last 12 months (Russia counts one year, even for 3-year vaccines).

steps.title: Other core vaccines
steps.detail: Distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus, adenovirus and leptospirosis.

steps.title: Clinical exam and vet passport / certificate
steps.detail: Exam recorded in the vet passport within 14 days before travel. Up to 2 pets with their owner travel on the vet passport; more pets, or a pet travelling without its owner, needs a Rosselkhoznadzor permit and an official certificate.

alerts: Check current flight routes from the UAE and airline live-animal rules for Russia before booking.
